suppress.notes: Added 2026-10-09. These advisories concern Checkstyle engines before 8.29 and 8.18, respectively, not the independently versioned Maven wrapper. The wrapper delegates to the separately scanned com.puppycrawl.tools:checkstyle engine, pinned by Airness to 14.1.0. No wrapper upgrade fixes an engine-to-wrapper product match. https://checkstyle.org/releasenotes.html#Release_8.29 https://checkstyle.org/releasenotes.html#Release_8.18

Added 2026-10-09. These advisories concern PMD engines through 5.8.1 and before 7.22.0, respectively, not the independently versioned Maven wrapper. Airness pins the separately scanned engine to 7.27.0. No wrapper upgrade fixes this product mismatch. https://github.com/pmd/pmd/issues/1650 https://github.com/pmd/pmd/security/advisories/GHSA-8rr6-2qw5-pc7r

Added 2026-10-09. These advisories concern Jenkins Recipe Plugin through 1.2 and its HTTP endpoints. OpenRewrite's rewrite-jenkins is a source transformation library from a different supplier; it contains none of those Jenkins endpoints. No upgrade applies to this name collision. https://www.jenkins.io/security/advisory/2022-06-30/#SECURITY-2000
